title: Guard the note-search count-selection SQL rewrite
outcome: A change to the catalog count selection cannot silently remove all note matches; the selection conversion fails clearly when its expected shape is absent.
acceptance: The note-search selection conversion guards its expected count-selection shape or shares the existing guarded conversion, returning a named projection error on an unexpected shape.
Existing note-search eligibility, metadata OR matching, counts and continuation behavior remain correct.

completion.summary: Guarded note-search count-selection conversion with named InvalidWorkProjection refusal; retained eligibility, metadata OR matches, counts and continuation behavior.
